svg.text: C-C at y=0 and D-D at x=3610 / exact solid cuts / geometric coverage does not establish material-flow performance
C-C / y0 / flow-zone crop, exact solid cut / 1:5
D-D / x3610 / concentrate inlet solid cut / 1:5
Both 660 mm inlets span the 600 mm belt. Concentrate narrows to 260 mm at x4000. Balance converges to a 136 mm approach
Width checks establish only modeled capture and guide surfaces. The 30 mm nominal allowance per belt edge is not a
The gate serves balance only and cannot recover already-ejected concentrate. Inhibit feed, verify drain time, command and
confirm position, then resume. Transition geometry is not an operating state.
Gate seats show nominal contact, not verified closure. Test fragment limits, bounce, jams, leakage and residence time.
Actuator, stops, seals, pneumatics and safeguarding remain unresolved.
DIMENSIONS: mm | SCALE: PER VIEW AT A3 | DO NOT SCALE FOR MANUFACTURE
Preliminary study geometry. Proposed inspection targets on sheet 8 are unapproved; no load, sensing or safety rating.
